verdicts.reason: Both share the same serious flaws. The SAVE 15% badge is blown up into the largest element and runs off the left canvas edge, so it overpowers the headline. The coffee bag, the key product image, has shrunk to an unreadable icon jammed between the CTA and a tiny logo. The right side is a blurry, empty photo block with nothing on it. A is worse because its body copy wraps onto two cramped lines and crowds the CTA, while B keeps the body copy on one line under a slightly larger headline, which gives a cleaner left-to-right read, although B leaves more dead dark space at the far right.
